title.narrative: AgrIOT smart irrigation system in Jordan

description.narrative: Smart Farm Sensing B.V. (SFS) is an agritech company that has developed the AgriIOT platform that supports smart irrigation and crop monitoring. This platform brings together data from satellite, aerial and surface measurements and makes a real-time analysis of the measured environmental data, with which irrigation systems are automatically controlled from the cloud based on crop, weather and soil conditions. The platform can improve irrigation management, conserve valuable water resources and improve crop health and productivity.Jordan is one of the most water-poor countries in the world. The chronic excessive use of water, particularly in the agricultural sector, which is responsible for no less than 70% of freshwater use, has led to a significant reduction of both ground and surface water. In addition, the consequences of climate change and strong population growth lead to even greater shortages. People are now looking for smart innovative technologies such as soil sensors, weather stations, wireless networks (IOT) etc, to irrigate with less water.The potential customer is the Jordanian system integrator Ad-Tech that designs and implements network and IT solutions and provides their customers with innovative solutions. Ad-Tech believes that with the smart irrigation solutions from SFS, in combination with its own advice, integration, installation and service, it can provide a lot of added value to the Jordanian agricultural sector, which is still lagging behind in the field of digitisation.With this study, SFS wants to demonstrate that it is technically, commercially, legally and organisationally feasible for Ad-Tech to offer the AgrIOT technology at a subscription rate in combination with Ad-Tech's services to both smaller and larger Jordanian agricultural companies.
